title: Weekly AI Worldview | Ex-Baidu Execs’ Genspark Raises $60M; OpenAI Buys Rockset; Ilya Launches SSI
summary: One week of global AI funding, events, and people. CN charts — attach on ingest (19 images).
author: Unique Research
html:
Unique Research · Weekly AI Worldview · June 24, 2024

One week of global AI funding, events, and people. CN charts — attach on ingest (19 images).

Funding

  • San Francisco AI Factory — $15M (Sequoia etc.), valuation >$100M, ~$20M cumulative; Lux, Hugging Face, Databricks CEO, The Chainsmokers. Product “Droids” automates features, review, vuln fixes; selling to Bubble, Podium, Stord. Geoffrey Hinton as board advisor. Competitors Poolside / Magic / Cognition already $100M+ raised.
  • Genspark — $60M seed led by LanChi Ventures; valuation $260M. Two ex-Baidu execs; AI search with “Sparkpage” structured topic pages; 200k Sparkpages created. (TechCrunch)
  • Aim Security — $18M Series A, Canaan lead, YL Ventures. Founders Matan Getz & Adir Gruss (2022); AI-native security for leakage/model attacks vs. reactive chat-tool risk. (Aim Security)
  • Decagon — $35M Series A led by Accel after $5M a16z seed. CEO Jesse Zhang & CTO Ashwin Sreenivas; generative AI agents for enterprise support beyond shallow chatbots. (Decagon)
  • Proofs — $2.6M pre-seed, Earlybird Digital East lead. Bartek Pucek & Zbigniew Sobiecki; AI agents cut API-first POCs from months to minutes at hundreds of dollars — aiming to democratize SaaS sales. (Proofs)

Events

  • NVIDIA market cap $3.335T briefly above Microsoft ($3.317T); quarterly revenue $26B, >3× YoY; Huang on “AI factories.”
  • Butterflies social app exits 5-month beta to iOS/Android; $4.8M seed (Coatue, SV Angel, ex-Snap angels); user-made AI “Butterflies” that post/interact. Founder Vu Tran (ex-Snap).
  • New Computer Dot on App Store — free trial / $12/mo; remembers conversations as a relational companion. Founders Jason Yuan (ex-Apple design) & Sam Whitmore; $3.7M from Lachy Groom, OpenAI Startup Fund, angels.
  • OpenAI acquires Rockset (Jun 22) — nine-figure stock deal; enterprise search/analytics + real-time / vector search for customers & developers. COO Brad Lightcap cited. (OpenAI)
  • Huawei Cloud Pangu 5.0 at HDC 2024 — full series, multimodal, stronger “thinking”; billion→trillion params; 10K ultra-HD; STCG for industry multimodal; chain-of-thought + policy search. CEO Zhang Pingan.
  • Alibaba Cloud Shanghai AI Summit — multi-agent “AI programmer” on Tongyi; demo built Olympic schedule app in ~10 minutes. Xu Dong: minute-level app era / “super individuals.”
  • Apple × China AI — WSJ (Jun 20): talks with Baidu, Alibaba, Baichuan to localize AI for China devices after slower progress importing global LLMs; Greater China ~18% of Q1 revenue.
  • DeepMind V2A — video-to-audio from pixels + text prompts (SFX, music, dialogue); autoregressive + diffusion; SynthID anti-abuse work ongoing.
  • Amazon Alexa — rumored GenAI overhaul and paid “Remarkable Alexa” at ~$5–10/mo; target upgrade before August; 500M+ Alexa devices. (Global Times Tech)
  • Runway Gen-3 Alpha (Jun 17) — higher-quality ~10s clips; joint training for structure/style/art direction; not yet public. (Runway)

People

  • Ilya Sutskever launches Safe Superintelligence Inc. (SSI) with Daniel Gross (ex-YC) & Daniel Levy (ex-OpenAI) — safe superintelligence first, no rush to products; offices Palo Alto & Tel Aviv. (Cailian)
  • Stability AI names ex-Weta Digital CEO Prem Akkaraju as CEO amid >$30M Q1 loss, debt, ~$1B valuation, Stable Diffusion 10M+ downloads; seeking fresh capital. (The Information)

— END —
